title: Sweet Dreams
survival_class: not stated as a class; header bullets read: You're Home . / You're Safe . / …Right? .
physical_identity: A wanderer's childhood bedroom (about age 9-12) under dim sterile white light with a single bed, inert appliances and an enterable infinite black void behind the door.
scale_topology: Small finite room per wanderer plus an infinite void; level is solitary and desynchronous.
anomalies: Void with lowered gravity and breathable air
Inert appliances except the light switch
lighting_sound: Dim sterile white light, musty smell (testimony); no ambient sound stated.

entities.name: Smilers
entities.behavior: Hide under the bed/in dark spaces; harmless while lights on; emerge and attack if lights off.

entities.name: Stress Mould
entities.behavior: Grows over time; anxiety-inducing; hazardous after ~8 hours.

entities.name: Window entities (malevolent liminal counterparts)
entities.behavior: Occasionally replace windows; only if the childhood room had windows.

entities.name: Bed bugs
entities.behavior: Infest the bedsheets; bite exposed skin causing rash.

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Smilers, Stress Mould, window entities
hazards: Falling into the void (death by dehydration)

entrances.method: Travel far beyond the limits of Level 29
entrances.quote: Travelling far beyond the limits of Level 29 supposedly leads to entry into Level 114 .

entrances.method: Enter any door labelled with an exit sign in corridors
entrances.quote: Entering any of the doors labelled with an exit sign in Level 109's corridors leads to Level 114.

exits.quote: Fall asleep in this room, and you will awake on a street on Level 9 .

exits.method: Say 'I'm so bored...' in a dull voice
exits.quote: Saying "I'm so bored…" in a dull voice leads you to Level 25 .

exits.method: Doorway to void: infinite drift, death by dehydration
exits.conditions: falling out of reach of the door
exits.quote: wanderers who fall out of reach of the doorway will continue drifting down into the darkness

signature_mechanic: A lonely childhood bedroom that must stay lit; the open doorway leads to a drifting void and sleep is the way out.
verticality: Void descends endlessly; the room is a single floor.
do_not: Do not add communities or other players.
Do not make the void a barrier wall; it is enterable.
Do not let batteries power the room's appliances.
Do not give a chase/entity in the void; the page says it appears devoid.
Do not treat interview details (pink stool, Barbie poster) as canonical room contents: they are one wanderer's testimony.
Do not add windows to every room: only if the childhood room had them.
content_warnings: psychological distress (interviewee describes infidelity, drinking, job loss)
implied death in the void by dehydration
conflicts_notes: Level 114 page says 115th Level of the Backrooms. Interview room details differ from the stated universal bed/sheet. Link list names Levels 113, 115 and 6 not described.

key_quotes.quote: It takes the form of each wanderer's childhood bedroom, with a black void extending infinitely behind the doorway.
The only functioning appliance found within the level seems to be the light switch, which is turned on by default.
Wanderers are advised not to turn off the lights in the room under any circumstances
it is not possible to swim upwards in the void
Fall asleep in this room, and you will awake on a street on Level 9 .
Saying "I'm so bored…" in a dull voice leads you to Level 25 .
